title: The Wealth of Nations, Mapped
excerpt: The world economy on one map you can play, from 10,000 BC to 2024. China and India made 45% of the world's output in 1820, 9% in 1950 and 30% in 2024, and the further back you go the more of the map is guesswork.
seo_description: GDP, GDP per head and shares of world output on an interactive map, from world estimates in 10,000 BC to 169 countries in 2024.
header_alt: Title card reading 'The Wealth of Nations, Mapped' in black and red on pale paper, beside three small world maps coloured by share of world GDP for 1820, 1950 and 2024. Text: China and India's share of world output: 45% in 1820, 9% in 1950, 30% in 2024.
